servicesPage.title: Services
servicesPage.intro: Three main needs, one request. Describe your site and we'll check what's available.

items.title: Concrete Delivery
items.short: For foundations, slabs, garages, extensions, renovations and other projects.
items.body: Ready-mix concrete delivery suits most residential and light commercial projects: footings, foundation walls, garage slabs, basement floors, sidewalks and driveways. Let us know the approximate volume, the desired date and the site access.
items.imageAlt: Ready-mix concrete truck at a construction site

items.title: Mobile Concrete
items.short: For projects where flexible quantities or on-site mixing may be advantageous.
items.body: Mobile concrete (volumetric mixer) mixes the concrete directly on site. This option can be useful when the exact volume is hard to estimate, when the pour is spread out over time, or when only a small volume is needed.

items.title: Concrete Pumping
items.short: For pours requiring a pump because of distance, height or limited access.
items.body: A concrete pump becomes necessary when the truck can't reach the pour area: backyard, basement, grade change, elevation or restricted access. If you're not sure, choose "I don't know" in the request and we'll assess it with you.

servicesPage.disclosure: BétonDispo works with a network of suppliers and operators to find a solution suited to your project. We do not produce the concrete and do not operate a fleet of trucks or pumps.
servicesPage.ctaBody: Send us the project details. We'll help you determine the right option.

faqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
faqPage.intro: Answers to the most common questions before sending a request.

items.question: How much concrete should I order?
items.answer: You can provide a rough estimate in cubic metres. If you don't know, select "I don't know" in the request: give us the dimensions or a description of the project and we'll confirm the quantity with you.

items.question: Does BétonDispo deliver the concrete?
items.answer: BétonDispo is not a concrete producer and does not operate a fleet. We work with a network of suppliers and operators to find a solution suited to your project, then coordinate the next steps with you.

items.question: Can I request a concrete pump?
items.answer: Yes. Indicate it in your request. If you're not sure whether a pump is needed, choose "I don't know" and describe the site access — we'll assess it with you.

items.question: Do you work with contractors?
items.answer: Yes, and we strongly encourage it. General contractors, excavation, foundations, landscaping, pools and renovation businesses can send us requests project by project. We keep the history on file to speed up future requests.

items.question: Which areas do you serve?
items.answer: We currently handle requests for the South Shore, Montréal and Greater Montréal. If your site is at the edge of that area, send the request anyway and we'll tell you whether we can help.

items.question: How long does it take to get a response?
items.answer: We process requests as quickly as possible depending on the date, area and project requirements. If your schedule is tight, mention it in the additional details.

items.question: Is this a confirmed booking?
items.answer: No. Submitting the form is a request. It is not a booking until availability, pricing and service details have been confirmed with you.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Pricing depends on volume, concrete type, date, area and specific requirements such as pumping. We don't publish prices on the site: we come back to you with the details once options have been checked.

items.question: Which concrete strength should I choose?
items.answer: Common residential projects often use 25 to 35 MPa depending on use and freeze exposure. If you don't know, select "I don't know": describe the project and we'll confirm with you. For structural work, refer to your drawings or your engineer.

faqPage.stillHaveQuestionsBody: Send your request and add your question in the additional details.

seo.howTitle: How do you calculate concrete quantity?
seo.howBody: Concrete quantity is calculated from the physical dimensions of the project. For a rectangular slab, multiply length, width and thickness. For a round shape, use the radius and height. The result is then converted to cubic metres for a clear cubic metre concrete calculator estimate.
seo.wasteTitle: How much extra concrete should I allow?
seo.wasteBody: An allowance can help cover small depth variations, site waste and irregular ground or formwork. The calculator lets you choose 0%, 5%, 10% or 15% depending on the level of uncertainty.
seo.unitsTitle: Which unit is used to order concrete in Québec?
seo.unitsBody: In Québec, concrete is generally ordered by the cubic metre. You can enter measurements in metric or imperial units; the calculator converts the result to m³ to simplify the quote request.
seo.unsureTitle: I do not know my exact dimensions
seo.unsureBody: You can still request a quote. Provide the dimensions you have, photos or a project description when submitting your request.
seo.ctaBody: Let us check availability for your area, date and concrete requirements.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: BétonDispo collects personal information for the sole purpose of processing quote requests and communicating with the people who submit them. This policy explains what information is collected, why, and how it is used.

sections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: When you submit a request, we collect the information you provide: name, company name (if applicable), email, phone, preferred contact method, project address or location, city, postal code, project type, approximate quantity, concrete specification, pump requirement, desired date and any additional details you add.

We also retain limited technical information related to your visit: landing page, referring site and campaign parameters (UTM) where applicable. This information is used to understand where requests come from.

sections.heading: How we use the information
paragraphs: The information is used to process your request, check available options with our network of suppliers and operators, and communicate with you about your project.
We do not sell your personal information. We do not subscribe you to marketing communications without your separate, explicit consent.

sections.heading: Disclosure of information
paragraphs: In order to check availability and obtain an option for your project, the necessary information (for example the area, project type, approximate volume and desired date) may be shared with suppliers or operators in our network.
We use technical service providers for site hosting, the database and transactional email. Those providers process the information solely on our behalf.

sections.heading: Retention
paragraphs: Requests are retained for as long as necessary for commercial follow-up and applicable legal obligations, then deleted or anonymized.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: The site uses a privacy-friendly analytics solution to measure traffic and the request funnel in aggregate. No information that identifies you (name, phone, email, address) is sent to the analytics tool.
The site does not use advertising or retargeting cookies.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You may request access to the personal information we hold about you, its correction, or its deletion, subject to the exceptions provided by law. You may also withdraw your consent to the processing of your request.
To exercise these rights, write to us at privacy@betondispo.ca.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: Information is transmitted over an encrypted connection and stored in a database with restricted access. Internal access is limited to the people who need to process requests.

sections.heading: Contact us
paragraphs: For any question about this policy or the handling of your personal information: privacy@betondispo.ca.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using betondispo.ca and submitting a request, you accept the terms below.

sections.heading: Nature of the service
paragraphs: BétonDispo is a request-centralization service. We receive your request, check available options with a network of suppliers and operators, and come back to you with a suitable solution.
BétonDispo is not a concrete producer and does not operate a fleet of trucks, volumetric mixers or pumps.

sections.heading: Requests are not bookings
paragraphs: Submitting the form constitutes a request for information. It creates no obligation for BétonDispo or for you, and does not constitute a booking, a contract, or a guarantee of availability or pricing.
A booking exists only once availability, pricing and service details have been explicitly confirmed with you.

sections.heading: Accuracy of information
paragraphs: You are responsible for the accuracy of the information provided, in particular the site location, access, desired date and estimated volume. Inaccurate information may make it impossible to find a suitable option.

sections.heading: No technical advice
paragraphs: The information presented on this site is general in nature and does not constitute engineering advice or a technical recommendation. For any structural work, refer to your drawings, your contractor or a qualified professional.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: The site is provided "as is". To the extent permitted by law, BétonDispo cannot be held liable for indirect damages arising from the use of the site or from the inability to find an option for a given project.

sections.heading: Governing law
